Что считается выполненной задачей: Передача заинтересованного клиента, готового обсудить свой проект и наши услуги. Требования: * Клиент должен быть реально заинтересован в сотрудничестве. * Рассматриваются проекты любой сложности в сфере IT. * Используются только законные способы поиска клиентов без спама и нарушения правил площадок. Если у вас есть опыт поиска клиентов, собственные источники трафика или другие эффективные способы привлечения потенциальных заказчиков, буду рад рассмотреть ваше предложение. jobs.title: NFC Asset Tracking System
jobs.description:
build an end-to-end NFC-Based Spare Parts & Asset Tracking System. The solution consists of a Cross-Platform Mobile App (Android/iOS) for field and warehouse operations, and a Web-Based Management Dashboard for real-time inventory and device tracking.

The primary goal of the system is to track high-value spare parts from the warehouse to field technicians, monitor their installation on specific medical/technical equipment, and trace any returns back to the warehouse.

System Architecture & Tech Stack Expectations
Mobile App: Flutter or React Native (Must support native NFC scanning on both Android and iOS).

Backend: Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python (FastAPI), or C# (.NET Core) with RESTful APIs.

Database: PostgreSQL or MySQL (Relational database structure with robust state-machine tracking).

Web Dashboard: React.js, Vue.js, or Next.js.

Core Workflows & Key Features
1. Warehouse Dispatch (Warehouse Staff)
Scan NFC tag on a spare part box using the mobile app.

Retrieve part details automatically via API.

Select the target Field Technician and target Medical Device/Equipment from dropdowns/search.

Update status to DISPATCHED.

2. Field Receipt & Installation (Field Technician)
Field technician receives the physical part and scans the NFC tag.

Confirms receipt → Status updates to RECEIVED_IN_FIELD.

Options to either:

Mount to Device: Tag assigned to the equipment → Status updates to INSTALLED_ON_DEVICE.

Return to Warehouse: Initiate return process → Status updates to RETURN_IN_TRANSIT.

3. Web Management Dashboard (Admins & Managers)
Live Inventory Tracking: Real-time status of all parts (In Warehouse, In Transit, Installed on Device, Returned).

Equipment-Centric View: Search a specific medical device/serial number to see all spare parts currently installed or historically replaced on it.

User & Asset Management: CRUD operations for Parts, Devices, Technicians, and Warehouses.

Audit Trail & Reports: Detailed transaction log (Who scanned what, when, and where). Export functionality (PDF / Excel).

NFC & Hardware Requirements
The mobile app must read standard NTAG213 / NTAG215 NFC chips .

NFC tags will hold a unique Hardware UID or encoded UUID (e.g., PRC-847291), which maps to the backend database record.

Key Deliverables
Source Code: Fully documented and clean repository (GitHub / GitLab).

Mobile App Builds: Working APK (Android) and TestFlight / IPA (iOS).

Web Dashboard: Deployed web admin portal.

API Documentation: OpenAPI / Postman collection for all endpoints.

Database Schema: Well-documented SQL migration scripts.

Developer Requirements / Qualifications
Proven experience with NFC integration in mobile apps (Flutter nfc_manager or React Native NFC libraries).

Strong background in building inventory management or asset tracking solutions.

Ability to design clean UI/UX for both mobile and web interfaces.

Clear communication and regular progress updates.

jobs.title: Multimodal Gene Text Disease Prediction
jobs.description:
I’m building a deep-learning system that can look at two very different kinds of information—gene-level data and free-form clinical text—and fuse them to predict whether a patient is likely to develop a target disease. The heart of the job is a multimodal architecture that treats gene features and textual features as complementary signals, learns their joint representation, and outputs a binary (disease / no-disease) or probabilistic risk score.

Here is what I need from you. First, a clean data-pipeline that ingests my gene expression matrices alongside the associated clinical notes, handles any necessary tokenisation or normalisation, and keeps sample alignment intact. Second, a well-documented model—PyTorch or TensorFlow is fine—that includes separate encoders for each modality and a fusion layer able to capture cross-modal interactions before the final prediction head. Finally, solid training and evaluation scripts with clear metrics such as AUC, accuracy, precision-recall and, ideally, an ablation option so we can see the added value of each modality.

Deliverables  
• Python source code (model, training, inference)  
• A runnable notebook or script that reproduces the main results on my sample dataset  
• README explaining environment setup, data expectations and how to fine-tune or extend the model  
• Short report summarising performance and any hyper-parameters chosen

Acceptance criteria  
• Model trains without errors on the provided dataset  
• Fusion variant beats single-modality baselines by a statistically meaningful margin  
• Reproducible metrics and clear, commented code

If you are comfortable working with multimodal deep learning, NLP preprocessing, and bioinformatics-style gene features, I’d love to see how you would approach this.

jobs.title: ChatGPT Support Chat Automation -- 4
jobs.description:

Here’s what I have so far:

What I’m missing—and what I’d like you to deliver—is a refined prompt-engineering workflow that teaches ChatGPT how to:
1. Detect intent from incoming chat messages.
2. Pull the correct answer (or the most relevant snippet) from the knowledge base.
3. Respond in a consistently friendly tone, adding light empathy and clear action steps.
4. Ask clarifying questions when needed rather than guessing.

Acceptance criteria
• A reusable prompt template (or short chain of prompts) that produces high-quality chat replies 90 %+ of the time in a test set of 100 unseen queries.  
• Integration code or no-code setup that plugs the workflow into Zendesk Chat and triggers within 1-2 seconds.  
• A quick reference guide so my non-technical team can tweak the system without breaking it.

Tools that will probably come into play: OpenAI API, Python (or a no-code alternative like Zapier/Make), vector search for the knowledge base (Weights & Biases, Pinecone, or whatever you prefer), and basic analytics to track response quality over time.

If you’ve already built something similar—or have a clever prompt structure that nails tone and accuracy—I’d love to see a short demo or example output when you respond.

jobs.title: Playwright Automation for Akamai Portals
jobs.description:
# Senior Playwright Engineer: Enterprise Session & Akamai Bot Manager Resilience

We are looking for an expert Playwright Engineer to refactor our data-ingestion automation layer. Our internal SaaS platform gathers authorized partner metrics from portals protected by modern security suites, specifically **Akamai Bot Manager**. 

Currently, our automated workflows suffer from frequent session invalidation and automated driver detection. We need a robust, production-grade Playwright (TypeScript) implementation built around long-lived session state persistence and resilient authentication.

---

## Key Technical Objectives

* **Playwright Native Architecture:** Leverage Playwright context management and `storageState` to maximize session longevity and minimize fresh login triggers.
* **WAF & Telemetry Consistency:** Configure execution contexts (both headful and headless) to eliminate default automation flags, ensuring TLS fingerprints, `navigator` properties, and browser telemetry match legitimate user contexts.
* **Complex MFA/OTP Integration:** Implement automated MFA hooks (Twilio SMS webhooks, IMAP/email listeners, or encrypted TOTP secrets) to handle dynamic auth challenges seamlessly.
* **Graceful Fallback:** Detect unexpected WAF blocks, CAPTCHAs, or HTTP 403 responses instantly, cleanly pausing execution or alerting an operator rather than causing account lockouts.

---

## Deliverables

1. **Production Automation Framework (TypeScript):** A modular Playwright framework capable of logging into target portals, maintaining valid `storageState` across executions, and running daily data-gathering flows.
2. **Session & Telemetry Modules:** Helpers for persistent cookie/storage management, automated driver flag mitigation, and dynamic OTP payload ingestion.
3. **CI/CD Integration & Docker Support:** Fully containerized setup ready for CI pipelines with environment-based secret injection.
4. **Documentation:** Comprehensive guide covering local execution, CI deployment, handling expired sessions, and updating browser context configurations as security rules evolve.

---

## Acceptance Criteria

* **Stable Session Persistence:** The application correctly reuses `storageState` across consecutive automated runs without triggering repeated login workflows.
* **Resilient Failure Handling:** In the event of an expired session or unexpected security challenge, the framework catches the error, redacts sensitive details from logs/screenshots, and cleanly exits or requests manual intervention.
* **Zero Secrets in Code:** Credentials, session tokens, and OTP secrets are loaded entirely from secure environment variables.
* **Clean CI Execution:** Framework successfully executes within a headless Docker environment using standard Playwright condition waits (no hardcoded fixed timeouts).

jobs.description:
# Full-Stack Developer — B2B SaaS for Water Well Management (Implementation on Existing Architecture)

## About us

We are a Brazilian water well drilling and maintenance company digitizing our entire operation — and building it as a multi-tenant SaaS from day one, with the goal of later offering the platform to other companies in our industry. We operate in Brasília, Brazil (UTC-3).

## What we are building

A B2B operations platform that sits at the intersection of three product categories:

1. **Field service management** (think ServiceTitan / Jobber, but for water wells): customers, work orders, field crews, equipment, field bulletins, a future offline-first mobile app for technicians.
2. **Contract & progress-measurement billing** (think Procore's commercial flow): versioned proposals, contracts with line items, amendments, field work measured against contract items, approval workflow, invoicing, Brazilian tax documents (NFS-e) and payment reconciliation.
3. **Water telemetry** (think HydroVu / AQUARIUS): continuous time series from field probes (water level, flow, conductivity, temperature), quality flags, provenance, alert rules.

Around this core: a CRM with customer dossiers and conversation history, document management on Google Drive (metadata in Postgres, binaries in Drive), Telegram bots (customer-facing for billing/status, internal for alerts and queries), payment collection through the **Asaas** gateway (Pix, boleto — webhooks), and later an MCP server so AI agents can query the platform under strict policies, plus RPA automation for Brazilian water-rights agencies.

## What already exists (read carefully — this defines the job)

We have a **versioned architecture and data-model baseline (v3.0.0 handoff package)** produced and validated statically. It contains:

- PostgreSQL/PostGIS **multi-tenant relational model**: ~147 tables across 19 domain schemas (platform, IAM, registry, CRM, commercial, operations, hydrogeology, observations, measurement, finance, post-construction, documents, integration, audit, MCP);
- **12 migrations** with tenant isolation enforced by Row-Level Security **and** composite foreign keys `(tenant_id, id)` on every tenant-scoped reference;
- seeds, SQL tests, invariants and **state machines** documented per domain;
- initial **OpenAPI 3.1 contract** (16 operations) and an **MCP tool catalog** with access policies;
- inbox/outbox event pattern with idempotency, audit and data-classification policies;
- Google Drive folder templates and a dry-run provisioning script;
- ADRs recording the closed architectural decisions.

**This engagement is about implementing the application layer on top of this baseline — NOT redesigning the data model.** Proposals to "start simple with Firebase/MongoDB" or rebuild the schema are an automatic no. Evolving the model through new migrations, with justification, is expected and welcome.

Job Title
Hiring Dedicated 5-Person Tech Team (PM, Python Scraper, Django Architect, Flutter/React Dev, UI/UX)

Job Description
We are seeking a dedicated, high-performing 5-person project team (or individual specialists forming a team) to design, build, and deploy an end-to-end B2B Lead Acquisition, Sales Automation, and Internal Workforce Platform.
The software consists of 6 integrated modules covering data extraction, multi-channel client outreach, real-time team messaging, and workforce productivity.

Key Modules & System Scope
Module 1: Data Scraper Pipeline — High-performance B2B directory & active job posting scrapers with anti-bot bypass and proxy management.
Module 2: Client Pipeline & Sales CRM — Kanban-style task tracking, daily sales goals, and client status dashboards.
Module 3: Multi-Channel Client Outreach — Cold email automation, web-to-SMS, VoIP/SIM call logging, and multi-channel messaging integrations.
Module 4: Calendar & Meeting Engine — Two-way sync (Google/Outlook), booking links, and automated meeting reminders.
Module 5: Proprietary Team Chat App — Standalone cross-platform (Mobile & Desktop) real-time messaging system using WebSockets.
Module 6: Workforce Management — Desktop monitoring agent for screenshot capture, time logging, and app/website activity tracking.

Required Team Roles & Tech Stack
We are hiring for the following 5 distinct roles:
1x Technical Product Manager / Project Lead: Agile sprint management, technical QA testing, code review, and milestone delivery.
1x Senior Data Extraction Engineer: Python, Scrapy, Playwright/Selenium, Proxy Rotation, Cloudflare Bypass.
1x Lead Backend Architect: Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Django Channels (WebSockets), Redis, Celery.
1x Cross-Platform Mobile & Frontend Engineer: React.js (Web Dashboard), Flutter (iOS/Android/Desktop Chat), Electron.js (Desktop Agent).
1x UI/UX Designer: Figma wireframes, component design systems, and responsive layouts.

Project Standards & Architectural Requirements
Modular Monolith Architecture Requirement: The backend must be built using a Modular Monolith architecture in Django. Each of the 6 modules must exist as an independent, loosely coupled app directory with its own API endpoints and database models. The system must support Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Feature Flags so that any individual module can be enabled, disabled, or accessed as a standalone tool per organization account.
Unified Core Backend: Core backend MUST be built strictly using Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL.
Code Ownership & Security: Daily Git commits forced directly to our company GitHub repository. Developers work with seed/dummy datasets; no raw production keys are exposed.
Deployment Readiness: All completed modules must include Docker containers and fully documented setup guides (README.md).
Execution Model: 2-week Agile Sprints with mandatory visual demos at the end of each sprint.

jobs.title: Research Prompt Writer (AI Training)
jobs.description:
I'm hiring detail-obsessed researchers to write tough, research-heavy questions that push the limits of today's best AI models. Your job is to craft prompts that require real web research to answer, pair each one with the single correct answer, and document exactly how that answer can be verified.

Every task you write becomes a training example that helps AI models get better at finding accurate answers on the web — faster, and with fewer confident mistakes. This is fully remote, self-paced freelance work with no cap on how many tasks you can complete.

- What you'll be doing
Write clear, natural-language questions that require web research and have exactly one verifiable answer.
Design each question to be complex enough that reaching the answer requires consulting at least 3 distinct sources.
Test your prompt against a state-of-the-art AI model to confirm it produces a genuine failure (an incorrect answer).
Write a step-by-step "golden trajectory" showing exactly how someone would find the correct answer from scratch.
List every source needed to independently verify the answer.
Revise and resubmit tasks based on automated and human reviewer feedback.

- What we're looking for
Strong internet research skills — you're comfortable searching efficiently, judging source credibility, and chaining multiple sources together to confirm a fact.
Adversarial, puzzle-oriented thinking — you enjoy building multi-step questions that are genuinely hard to solve.
Exceptional attention to detail — exact names, dates, numbers, and URLs matter; small errors invalidate a task.
Clear technical writing — you can write reproducible, step-by-step instructions a stranger could follow to reach the same answer.
Persistence — you're willing to iterate and revise until a task meets the bar.
Reliable internet access and the ability to follow setup instructions precisely.

- Nice to have
Solid knowledge of one or more domains (e.g. sports, history, science, finance, geography) — subject expertise makes it easier to craft difficult, verifiable questions.
Background in OSINT, competitive/market research, journalism, library or information science, or fact-checking.
Prior experience with AI data annotation or model evaluation.

jobs.title: AutoCAD Mechanical System Design Drafting
jobs.description:
I’m building a new mechanical system that centres on pumps and valves, and I need a qualified engineer to turn my concepts into production-ready documentation. Your main platform will be AutoCAD; every model, drawing and calculation must be delivered in native DWG along with exported PDFs.

Scope  
• Translate my functional requirements into a complete mechanical layout.  
• Create detailed 3D and 2D AutoCAD models of the system, focusing on accurate pump and valve integration and all associated pipework, supports and fasteners.  
• Produce fully dimensioned manufacturing drawings with GD&T, material call-outs and an organised BOM.  
• Supply the underlying engineering calculations—flow, pressure drop, stress and any sizing formulas—to substantiate the design.

Acceptance Criteria  
• All files open error-free in the latest AutoCAD release.  
• Drawings are to ISO standards and ready for fabrication without rework.  
• Calculations are clear, traceable and match the geometry shown.  
• Final package is submitted on or before the agreed deadline.

If you have a proven track record in mechanical system design, particularly around pump and valve assemblies, and can keep communication concise and responsive, I’m ready to get started right away.

jobs.title: Rideshare App Development Assistance
jobs.description:
I'm building a rideshare app and need guidance and help finishing the project. 

I need assistance in a few areas:
- User Interface Design: I need guidance on how to create an intuitive and user-friendly layout.
- Backend Development: I require help with server-side logic to ensure smooth operations.
- Integrating Payment Systems: I need assistance in setting up secure payment processing.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience in mobile app development, especially in rideshare platforms.
- Strong UI/UX design skills.
- Proficiency in backend technologies and server-side logic.
- Familiarity with various payment gateways and integration methods.

Looking for a collaborator who can provide both technical expertise and strategic guidance.

jobs.title: 1-on-1 Shopify Coach: Build Store + Affiliate Portal (Dawn Theme)
jobs.description:
Project OverviewI am a tech-literate, retired individual looking to build my own Shopify e-commerce store using the free Dawn theme. I am a quick learner. I do not want you to build the website for me. Instead, I want to hire a patient Shopify Coach/Tutor to guide me through the setup process during live video sessions so I can do the actual execution myself.

Scope of WorkYou will guide me through the following setups via live screen-share training:

Theme Customization: Setting up the Dawn theme layout, navigation menus, and standard pages.

Product Catalog: Creating 2 collections with 15 products each (30 products total).

Referrer / Affiliate Portal: Installing and configuring a Shopify affiliate app (e.g., Goaffpro or UpPromote) to give verified referrers their own personalized tracking link and a custom QR code that drives customers directly to their profile to buy.

Payment Gateway Integration: Walking me through the standard Shopify process for connecting third-party payment provider plugins.

Shipping / Courier Integration: Assisting with the installation and basic setup of localized courier or shipping tracking apps via the Shopify App Store.

Training Format, Pace, & Timeline

Project Duration: 2 Months (60 Days Total) to allow thorough practice and implementation.

Session Schedule: 1 live session approximately every 10 to 12 days.

Type: Live 1-on-1 coaching via Zoom or Google Meet.

Time: Approximately 10–15 hours total, split into manageable 2-hour training sessions.

Language: Fluent spoken English.

Budget & Financial MilestonesFixed Budget: $200 total for the complete training package.

Pay-As-You-Go Escrow: Payments are released incrementally in equal parts after each live training session is completed ($40 per milestone for 5 sessions).

Pacing Notice: Milestones will be funded and released across a spanned 2-month period. Do not apply if you require immediate project completion.

Freelancer Requirements

Deep experience with Shopify, the Dawn theme, and Shopify Affiliate apps.
Excellent, clear spoken English communication skills.
High patience and a proven track record in technical tutoring or coaching.
Reliable internet connection for smooth screen sharing.

jobs.title: Local Services Booking Website
jobs.description:
I’m building an online hub where people can quickly find and book trusted local plumbers, electricians, cleaners, and other household pros. I need a developer-designer who can take the site from blank screen to launch-ready, handling both the visual polish and the behind-the-scenes logic.

Core experience for visitors  
• Browse or search by service and location  
• Check authentic customer ratings and written reviews before committing  
• Reserve an exact date and time through a smooth, multi-step booking flow  
• Pay on the spot with major cards or mobile wallets, then receive an instant confirmation email

Back-office needs  
• An intuitive dashboard where I can approve new provider listings, moderate reviews, and track completed jobs and payouts  
• Automatic emails/notifications to keep clients and providers informed of booking status, reschedules, or cancellations  
• Responsive design that works flawlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop

Preferred stack is flexible—as long as the final product is fast, secure, and easy for a non-developer to update (WordPress + WooCommerce/Bookly, Laravel + Vue, or a comparable framework are all fine). Clean code, clear documentation, and a short hand-over call at the end will let me maintain the site without surprises.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria)  
1. Pixel-perfect, responsive UI delivered from approved Figma or Adobe XD mocks  
2. Fully functional review & rating module tied to completed bookings only  
3. End-to-end booking system with calendar, availability rules, email notifications, and admin override  
4. PCI-compliant payment gateway integration, tested in sandbox and live modes  
5. Admin dashboard, roles & permissions, and basic analytics setup  
6. Deployment to my hosting plus a concise maintenance guide

If you’re comfortable owning both design and development for a polished, conversion-focused marketplace, I’d love to see links to similar projects and hear your proposed tech stack.

jobs.title: B2B Photorealistic Product Video for BalmSaver
jobs.description:
• Create a professional B2B product video for a patent-pending lip balm accessory called BalmSaver.

• This is NOT a consumer advertisement, social media video, or cartoon-style explainer.

• Desired video length is approximately 2½ to 3 minutes. It should clearly explain the consumer problem, demonstrate the product, and communicate the licensing opportunity in a concise, engaging format.

• I want a photorealistic, premium-quality product demonstration that looks professionally produced.

• Use realistic AI-generated people, hands, and environments where appropriate. The final result should appear natural and believable, not animated or cartoonish.

• Professional-quality English narration is required. AI-generated narration is acceptable if it sounds natural, polished, and appropriate for a corporate business presentation.

• The target audience is packaging manufacturers, product development teams, and potential licensing partners such as Inpres, Plastek, and similar companies.

• The video should clearly explain the consumer problem, demonstrate how BalmSaver retrieves usable lip balm remaining below the platform and around the center screw, and show how it stores conveniently on a standard lip balm tube.

• Clearly communicate that BalmSaver is a standalone external accessory that requires no changes to the lip balm tube, formulation, manufacturing process, or filling process.

• Position BalmSaver as a scalable, value-added opportunity that enhances the consumer experience while creating additional value for manufacturers and brands through licensing.

• I will provide product photos, product renderings, branding materials, and product information.

• The selected freelancer will collaborate on the storyboard, script, narration, realistic scenes, editing, text overlays, and final video.

• The finished video should have a polished corporate presentation style suitable for executive meetings, licensing presentations, and business development.

• Experience producing high-end product demonstrations, corporate marketing videos, or photorealistic AI-assisted product videos is strongly preferred.

• U.S.-based applicants only.

• Please include examples of similar B2B product videos or product demonstration videos with your proposal.

• Project scope, deliverables, timeline, milestones, and revision process will be finalized with the selected freelancer before work begins.

jobs.title: Hand-Illustrated, Playful Yarn Company Logo
jobs.description:
I'm seeking a talented designer to create an original hand-drawn, playful and colorful logo for my yarn company. The logo will feature a sheep and a moon but I am otherwise open. The logo should capture the fun and creativity associated with yarn and crafting and feature a cohesive color palette. It should feel whimsical, a little dreamy, and not corporate.

Requirements:
- Modern and minimalistic, or playful and colorful styles welcome
- Open to color suggestions
- No AI art

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Strong portfolio showcasing past human-made work
- Experience in creating logos, especially for craft or textile-related businesses
- Ability to provide creative and vibrant color options
- Unique, cohesive style with a portfolio that looks like it belongs to one artist
 
Please include past work in your application.

jobs.title: AI Copy & Prompt Specialist
jobs.description:
I’m running an ongoing content initiative and need a partner who can blend copywriting craft with solid prompt-engineering skills. Social media posts will be your daily bread, so every caption, thread, or short-form piece you deliver should feel effortlessly conversational and unmistakably on brand.

Here’s what we’ll tackle together:

• Drafting ready-to-publish social content with ChatGPT at the core, plus the occasional blog intro or marketing snippet when required.  
• Building and iterating a library of custom prompts so future content rolls out faster, sharper, and always in the right voice.  
• Setting up a lightweight, reusable workflow I can plug into my own systems after the engagement.  

You’ll work directly with me, fine-tuning tone, reviewing analytics feedback, and revising promptly to meet deadlines. Fluent English, dependable communication, and a portfolio showing AI-generated copy or prompt work are non-negotiable—send your best samples when you apply so I can see your style in action.

If conversational storytelling powered by ChatGPT is your comfort zone and you thrive on collaborative iteration, let’s talk.

jobs.title: AI Sales-Driven Marketing System
jobs.description:
I need a turnkey AI-powered marketing engine that can take my existing offers and turn them into steady, measurable sales. My priority is simple: more revenue. I’m not sure which specific algorithms, data layers or dashboards will get us there—so I’m counting on you to map out the architecture and build it end-to-end.

Focus first on social media and SMS because that’s where my audience lives. The system should be able to:

• Pull data from my socials and previous SMS blasts, learn which messages convert, and automatically craft new variants.  
• Predict the best send time, audience segment and spend for each post or text.  
• Launch, monitor and optimise campaigns without constant human oversight, surfacing clear reports that show uplift in sales.

I’ll supply account access, brand assets and historical performance data. You’ll design the data flow, choose or build the AI models, integrate scheduling/analytics tools, and hand over a fully functional platform or documented workflow I can run myself.

Acceptance criteria  
• A working automation that creates, schedules and refines social posts and SMS in real time.  
• A dashboard (or clear reporting method) that attributes sales increases to specific AI-driven actions.  
• A brief video or live walk-through so I understand how to maintain and scale the system.

When you apply, show past work where you used AI to lift sales—screenshots, case studies or links are fine. Let me see results, not just theory. I’m ready to move quickly once I know you’ve done this before.

jobs.title: Ghostwrite and edit historical fiction on Costa Rica chapters of a novel

jobs.title: Design WordPress E-Commerce Business Website
jobs.description:
My WordPress install needs to evolve into a streamlined business site that actively sells my products and services. The build must feel professional on the front end while staying easy for me to update on the back end.  

Core objectives  
• Present the brand clearly and guide visitors straight to purchase.  
• Integrate a robust product search feature so shoppers can quickly locate items.  
• Display genuine customer reviews on product pages to build trust and boost conversions.  

Key notes  
– Theme choice is flexible as long as it is lightweight, fully responsive, and WooCommerce-ready.  
– Clean UI/UX and fast load times are non-negotiable.  
– All styling should remain consistent with my existing brand colours and typography.

jobs.title: Website Content Refresh & Access Help
jobs.description:

• Updated text and images across all pages, optimised for load speed

jobs.title: Photobooth Funnel & Website Build
jobs.description:
I run a growing photobooth business and I’m starting from square one with my online sales funnel. I need someone who has already built high-converting funnels for photography or event-based companies and can guide the entire process—from the first ad click all the way to a paid booking and signed contract.

The funnel must cover three core elements:
• Lead generation that attracts local event planners, brides, and corporate clients  
• Automated email follow-ups that nurture those leads until they’re ready to book  
• Sales conversion pages that make it effortless to choose a package and pay a deposit  

Alongside the funnel, I also need a streamlined website. It has to accept deposits securely, trigger an online contract for e-signature the moment payment is made, and showcase a clean gallery of past events so prospects can see what the booth looks like in action.

I’m platform-agnostic—as long as the solution is easy for me to manage later. If you’re skilled with tools such as ClickFunnels, WordPress + Elementor, Kajabi, Squarespace, or a similar stack, let me know which you recommend and why.

Deliverables I’m expecting:
1. A fully implemented funnel (ads or lead magnet entry point, email sequence, and checkout/booking page) that is live and tested.  
2. A mobile-friendly website integrated with my payment processor and e-signature provider, complete with an events gallery.  
3. Clear hand-off documentation so I can update copy, change images, and add new events without coding.  

If you can also set up basic analytics so I can track opt-in rates and conversions, that’s a plus. Please share links to at least one live funnel and one event-oriented site you’ve built so I can gauge fit.

jobs.title: Budget Travel Guide Blog Writer
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a new series of travel posts aimed squarely at readers who want to see the world without burning through their savings. Each article should read like a step-by-step guide: where to stay, how to move around, the cheapest times to visit, and clever ways to cut daily costs.  

You’ll take one destination at a time and break it down into clear, actionable sections—transport, food, lodging, and must-do experiences—sprinkling in local tips that only a savvy budget traveler would know. Tone should stay friendly and encouraging, but every claim needs to be backed by current prices, reliable links, or recent first-hand data.  

Strong SEO practices are important, yet I don’t want keyword stuffing; flow and readability come first. If you work in WordPress, please format with headings (H2/H3), short paragraphs, and metadata ready to drop straight into the CMS.  

Deliverables for each post (800–1,200 words):
• Optimized title & meta description  
• Well-structured, informative guide covering the essentials for budget travelers  
• At least three outbound links to authoritative resources  
• Royalty-free images (properly attributed) or original photos if you have them  

Send a quick note with two sample travel guides you’ve written—preferably ones that target low-cost itineraries—plus a brief outline for your first proposed destination.

jobs.title: Sneaker Store eCommerce Site Development
jobs.description:
Sneaker E-commerce Website Project 

I need a modern, professional, and mobile-friendly sneaker e-commerce website for my business based in Zambia. The business model is simple: customers browse sneakers, place orders, pay online, and I source the products directly from suppliers in China before delivering them to customers in Zambia.

Main Features

- Clean and modern sneaker store design.
- Homepage with featured and latest sneakers.
- Categories (Nike, Adidas, New Balance, Jordan, Puma, etc.).
- Search and filter by size, brand, color, gender, and price.
- High-quality product images with multiple photos.
- Product descriptions, available sizes, and prices in Zambian Kwacha (ZMW).
- Wishlist and shopping cart.
- Customer account registration and login.
- Secure checkout process.

Payment Methods

The website should support local Zambian mobile money payments:

- Airtel Money
- MTN MoMo

Customers should receive an order confirmation after successful payment.

Order Process

1. Customer selects sneakers.
2. Customer places an order.
3. Customer pays using Airtel Money or MTN MoMo.

The product catalogue will be handled later, so focus your energy on these two modules and make the code modular enough for future expansion.

• REST endpoints for sign-up, login, logout and token refresh  
• Payment processing endpoints wired to the chosen gateway, fully tested with sandbox credentials  
• Environment configuration files plus a simple deployment script (Docker or similar)  
• Postman (or Swagger) collection and concise Markdown documentation covering auth flows, payment sequence and error codes  

Acceptance criteria
• All endpoints respond with standardised JSON and appropriate HTTP status codes  
• Auth flow passes basic penetration tests; tokens cannot be forged or reused after logout

Feel free to use Node.js, Django, Laravel or another mainstream framework you’re comfortable with; just keep the code neat, unit-tested and ready to drop onto AWS or Heroku.

jobs.title: Playwright-based Web Automation Remote User Interaction
jobs.description:
Description:

I have a fully functional Playwright-based web automation system that needs one final piece to go live in production: enabling end users to view and interact with the Playwright-controlled browser remotely through a web interface.

Tech Stack:

Node.js
Playwright
Prisma ORM
MySQL
PM2
Nginx

Current Status (Working):

The application runs perfectly in local development with headless: false — login automation, search automation, form interactions, navigation monitoring, data extraction, database operations, and push notifications all work correctly.
Full VPS deployment is complete: server configured (Ubuntu, Node.js, Chrome, Playwright, MySQL, Prisma), database connected via Prisma, the Node app runs on port 3000, PM2 manages the process with auto-restart, and Nginx reverse proxy is set up and working.
We resolved the "Missing X server / $DISPLAY" issue using Xvfb — Chrome launches successfully in a virtual display, and PM2 logs confirm the browser opens and pages load correctly under Xvfb.

The Problem:
Because the VPS has no physical display, Chrome runs inside a headless/virtual (Xvfb) session. The automation itself works, but end users cannot see or interact with the browser — the session isn't exposed anywhere.

What I Need Built:
Implement a browser streaming solution so users can view and interact with the same live browser instance that Playwright is controlling, without breaking the existing automation logic. Recommended approach (open to alternatives):

XFCE Desktop (already installed) + TigerVNC
noVNC for browser-based streaming access
WebSocket proxy configuration
Nginx integration + HTTPS
Launch Chrome inside the streamed desktop session so Playwright and the user share the same browser instance

Deliverables:

Working noVNC/TigerVNC + XFCE setup on our VPS, streaming the live browser to users via web browser
Nginx + WebSocket + HTTPS configuration for secure remote access
Verified that Playwright continues to monitor/control the same browser session users are viewing
Documentation of the setup and configuration
(Nice to have) Guidance or setup for future scaling: per-user session isolation, timeout/cleanup handling, multi-user support

jobs.title: Workflow Automation Development - PHP/MySQL & Claude Code Specialist
jobs.description:
Position: Senior PHP/MySQL Engineer (Claude Code Specialist) - Workflow Automation Platform, Long Term

We are a U.S. professional services firm building an internal workflow automation platform to replace a licensed third-party system. This is a long-term engagement, six months or more, for one senior engineer.

WHAT EXISTS
We have a design skeleton, not a finished system:
  - A draft MySQL 8 schema (definition/runtime separation, RBAC, audit tables)
  - A prototype workflow engine validated against a real workflow definition
  - An importer that normalizes an existing workflow export of ~290 activities and ~5,000 tasks
  - Skeleton auth, audit logging, and cron scaffolding

This has not been run in a live environment and is not a vetted production architecture. We expect you to review it critically and tell us where it is wrong before you build on it. Candidates who accept it uncritically are not what we are looking for.

THE STACK
  - PHP 8.1+, zero third party dependencies (PDO, openssl, password_* only; no Composer, no framework)
  - MySQL 8 on AWS (Linux)
  - Server rendered PHP with light vanilla JS. No SPA framework.
  - Must work across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge
  - Cron driven background processing

THE CORE PROBLEM
A configurable workflow engine. A workflow is a template of approximately 290 activities, each gated by conditions: data comparisons, checklist selections, and task predecessors. The engine evaluates each case's data and instantiates only the activities whose triggers fire. The engine is domain agnostic, so additional workflows are data rather than code. Work routes to queues with load balanced distribution across approximately 20+ users. The system handles deadline ticklers, confirmable dates, and hold and close behavior.

AI ARCHITECTURE
A two-tier design. You must be comfortable with both:
  - Local tier: a dedicated Mac server running Ollama, handling high volume, routine, and privacy sensitive work including document assembly from templates, field extraction, classification, and summarization. Zero marginal cost, and data does not leave our infrastructure.
  - Cloud tier: the Anthropic Claude API for work requiring higher level reasoning.
You will build a routing and abstraction layer that selects the tier based on task type and data sensitivity, so either tier can be replaced without touching calling code. Every AI generated document must pass a human approval gate before finalization. This requirement is not negotiable.

REPORTING
The platform exchanges data in both directions with a third-party financial model maintained outside the system. Egress: stable star schema views over the transactional tables, exposed through a least privilege read only account. Ingress: a validated import path for external financial data, staged into dedicated tables, with schema validation, rejection handling, and a load log. Each data element has a single system of record and neither side overwrites the other's authoritative data

jobs.description: Требуется специалист для обхода капчи в скрипте, который производит рассылку на приложение Танго. Оплата будет произведена по факту выполнения работы. Необходимо наличие опыта работы с подобными задачами.

jobs.title: Разработать 2 скрипта Python
jobs.description: Требуется разработать два скрипта на Python для обработки данных с веб-сайтов. Скрипты должны быть эффективными и соответствовать современным стандартам программирования. Уточните спецификации и требования к обработке данных.

jobs.title: Crm срочно
jobs.description: Ищется технический специалист для работы с CRM. Задачи: интеграция мессенджеров в Amo, оптимизация автоцепочек, создание TG-бота, обучение сотрудников и внедрение аналитики. Необходимы решения для автоматизации и улучшения бизнес-процессов. Ожидается указание цены и сроков выполнения задач.

jobs.title: Доработка AmoCRM + кастомная интеграция SaleBot (API)
jobs.description: Требуется технический специалист для доработки AmoCRM и интеграции с SaleBot. Задачи включают подключение мессенджеров, оптимизацию автоцепочек, создание тг-бота, обучение сотрудников и внедрение аналитики. Ожидается решение по интеграции и оптимизации бизнес-процессов. Важно указать цену и срок выполнения работ.

jobs.title: Скрипт перевода бинарного файла прошивки автомагнитолы через DEEPL Api
jobs.description: Необходимо разработать скрипт на Python для перевода бинарной прошивки автомагнитолы через DEEPL API. Скрипт должен учитывать специфику перевода, оставлять аббревиатуры и переменные без изменений, заменять непереводимые части на плейсхолдеры. Также требуется создать словарь частых фраз и обеспечить соответствие длины итоговой строки оригиналу. Работа скрипта должна быть протестирована на стандартной сборке Ubuntu.

jobs.title: Парсер событий с сайта университета
jobs.description: Необходимо создать программу-парсер на Python для извлечения событий с сайта университета. Программа должна сохранять данные в CSV файл с полями: название, вид события, место проведения, дата проведения и категория. Требуется передать рабочую программу и инструкцию по запуску.

jobs.title: Система управления закупками для строительной компании
jobs.description: Ищется команда или опытный fullstack-разработчик для создания внутренней B2B-системы по автоматизации закупок строительных материалов. Проект включает разработку веб-системы и Mini-App в мессенджере Max. Ожидается оценка трудозатрат, план разработки и портфолио релевантных проектов. Стек: Python, React, PostgreSQL.

jobs.title: Twitch drop farmer
jobs.description: Требуется разработка программы для фарма Twitch Drops с графическим интерфейсом или в командной строке. Основные функции: подключение нескольких аккаунтов, автоматизация просмотра стримов, логирование действий и оптимизация нагрузки. Программа должна поддерживать работу через прокси и VPN, а также обеспечивать автоматическое переключение между стримами и уведомления о завершении фарма дропа.

jobs.title: Бот автоматизатор для бронирования слотов и прохождения видео-верифика
jobs.description: Необходимо разработать автоматизированного бота для записи в визовый центр VFS Global. Он должен выполнять мониторинг доступных слотов, автоматическое бронирование и прохождение видео-верификации, обеспечивая стабильную работу 24/7. Важные задачи включают авторизацию, уведомления в Telegram и интеграцию с виртуальной камерой. Опыт в веб-скрейпинге и автоматизации обязательный.

jobs.title: Парсинг данных из сайта авито
jobs.description: Необходим парсер для сайта Авито, который будет извлекать временные номера телефонов и другую информацию по заданным фильтрам. Парсер должен работать на сервере, управляться через Телеграм-бота и выдавать данные в формате xls. Нужно обеспечить ежедневный сбор данных, а также дальнейшую поддержку для адаптации к изменениям сайта-донор.

jobs.title: Исправить ошибки в скрипте Python
jobs.description: Требуется фрилансер для исправления ошибок в скрипте на Python. Подробности о проекте будут предоставлены позже. Задача включает анализ и исправление кода, чтобы он работал корректно.

jobs.title: Разработка скриптов для высокостабильной замены лица
jobs.description: Требуется кастомное решение для замены лица в видео длиной до 3 минут с использованием одного фото. Обеспечить абсолютную стабильность, устойчивость к движениям и обработку перекрытий. Сдать рабочие скрипты на Python с инструкцией по запуску. Важно достичь быстрой генерации видео на стандартной видеокарте.

jobs.title: [Python] Создать десктоп программу Windows 10/11
jobs.description: Требуется разработать десктоп программу на Python для Windows 10/11, которая будет автоматизировать отклики на вакансии на одном сайте. Бот должен соблюдать лимиты, обеспечивать базовую релевантность и минимизировать риск блокировок при откликах, сохраняя качество взаимодействия.

jobs.title: Разработать сервис по бронированию записи, начать сразу
jobs.description: Требуется разработать сервис по бронированию записей в испанские гос сервисы, включая полицию и миграционную службу. Пользователь вводит данные, выбирает нужный сервис и дату, а система автоматически проверяет наличие записи и уведомляет пользователя. Бюджет 1000$, работа на сервере, оплата поэтапно.

jobs.title: Исследование защищенности сетевых протоколов GSM/LTE/5G
jobs.description: Проведите технический анализ и аудит безопасности протоколов GSM, LTE и 5G. Задача включает анализ уязвимостей базовых станций, разработку инструментария на Python или C++ для автоматизации анализа сетевого трафика, а также реверс-инжиниринг прошивок терминальных устройств. Необходимы знания архитектуры сетей и опыт работы с Wireshark, Osmocom или srsRAN.

jobs.title: Переделать меню
jobs.description: Необходимо переделать меню для нейросети, используемой в игре Brawl Stars. Дизайн уже готов, требуется внести изменения в код для реализации нового внешнего вида, согласно представленному скриншоту.

jobs.title: Разработка бота для автоматической записи на VFS Global
jobs.description: Требуется разработка бота для автоматической записи на VFS Global. Функционал включает мониторинг доступных дат, автоматическое заполнение анкет, запись на слот, подтверждение и оплату сервисного сбора. Необходима работа 24/7 с высокой скоростью реакции, использование прокси, логирование и уведомления. Технологии: Python (Playwright/Selenium) или аналогичные решения.

jobs.title: устранить баг бота питон
jobs.description: Требуется программист для устранения бага бота, написанного на Python. Необходим опыт работы с API биржи для эффективного решения задачи.

jobs.title: Ищу верстальщика / frontend-специалиста под проект.
jobs.description: Ищется верстальщик для создания адаптивной HTML-страницы по готовому дизайну в Figma. Ожидается качественная верстка с использованием Django-шаблонов и соблюдением SEO-требований. Важно внимание к деталям и pixel-perfect. Возможен большой объем работы при успешном завершении первой страницы.

jobs.title: Выполнить доработки Python-скриптов
jobs.description: Требуется доработка существующих Python-скриптов, которые выполняют сбор данных, формируют Excel-отчеты и отправляют информацию в Telegram. Необходимо улучшить функциональность и оптимизировать код для повышения производительности.

jobs.title: Разработать чат бота ВКонтакте (такси)
jobs.description: Требуется разработка чат-бота такси для ВКонтакте с функциями для клиентов и водителей. Клиенты могут заказывать такси, а водители управляют заказами через интерфейс. Веб-админка для управления заказами и пользователями. Используемые технологии: Python, PostgreSQL, Redis. Необходимы исходники, инструкция по развертыванию и работающий тестовый бот.

jobs.title: Python Backend разработчик FastAPI
jobs.description: Требуется Python разработчик для поддержки и доработки существующей кодовой базы. Стек: Python 3.11 FastAPI PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy + alembic) aiogram PyMongo Необходимые навыки: Опыт работы с REST ...

jobs.title: Доработать сайт, исправить баги
jobs.description: Необходимо доработать образовательную платформу, исправить баги и подготовить к полноценному релизу. Проект включает backend на Python (Fastapi, Redis, Postgresql) и frontend на NextJS с использованием Typescript и Tailwind. Опытный программист с навыками работы с Git и Docker требуется для завершения проекта.

jobs.title: Создание ботов
jobs.description: Требуется разработчик с опытом для создания ботов, которые будут бронировать визиты на сайте. Задача включает работу с защитой Cloudflare и языком программирования Python. Необходима высокая скорость выполнения, так как визиты быстро раскупаются. Ожидается сотрудничество на постоянной основе.

jobs.title: Фраймворк Оду (на питоне)
jobs.description: Необходимо наладить интеграцию фреймворка Оду на Python с различными банками и физической кассой. Также требуется провести сверку по счетам для обеспечения точности данных. Ищем специалистов с опытом работы в веб-программировании и интеграции финансовых систем.

jobs.title: Вакансия: Разработчик арбитражного крипто-терминала
jobs.description: Ищется разработчик для создания арбитражного крипто-терминала. Основные функции: мониторинг рынков, поиск арбитража, автоматизация сделок и интерфейс. Требуется опыт работы с API бирж, понимание арбитража и навыки в Python или Node.js. Возможна дальнейшая поддержка проекта и долгосрочное сотрудничество.

jobs.title: Необходим специалист Python со знаем: Selenium, Pandas, OpenPyXL,Java
jobs.description: Ищется специалист Python со знанием Selenium, Pandas и OpenPyXL для автоматического парсинга цен с авторизованного кабинета. Необходимо собрать данные с сайта и выгрузить их в шаблон Excel. Также требуется настройка скрипта для автоматического создания скриншотов.

jobs.title: Десктопное приложение: Парсер Excel + Генератор PDF-бланков по реестру
jobs.description: Требуется разработать десктопное приложение для Windows, которое будет автоматически создавать типовые бланки на основе данных из Excel. Пользователь загружает файл и выбирает нужные позиции, а программа генерирует папку с PDF-документами. Возможны любые технологии, главное — отсутствие тяжелых фреймворков. Бюджет 70 000, срок выполнения 4–6 недель.

jobs.title: Провести аудит кода на Питоне, без ИИ - руками, срочно
jobs.description: Необходимо провести аудит кода на Питоне вручную, без использования ИИ. Важно предоставить отчет по факту выполнения работы. Бюджет составляет 40$. Оплата производится после готовности отчета, авансов нет.

jobs.title: Playwright + питон, скрипт с обходом каптчи (API) и авторизацией
jobs.description: Требуется разработка скрипта на Python с использованием Playwright для обхода капчи (API) и авторизации. Доступно ТЗ и некоторые наработки. Оплата 150$ по факту выполнения. Результатом работы должен стать скрипт, записывающий действия через авторизацию в Chrome и успешно проходящий капчу. Срок выполнения — 1-2 часа.

jobs.title: Разработать новостной сайт на wordpress с автоматическим заполнением
jobs.description: Требуется разработать новостной сайт на платформе WordPress с функционалом автоматического добавления новостей с других сайтов. Основные требования: парсинг новостей, возможность загрузки из файлов или БД, ручное добавление статей, страницы с новостями, информацией о сайте и разделом для мнений пользователей. Обсуждение источников парсинга с исполнителем.

jobs.title: Менеджер по продажам (без опыта)
jobs.description: Открыта вакансия менеджера по продажам без опыта. Основные обязанности: консультирование клиентов, ведение переговоров, подготовка коммерческих предложений и сопровождение сделок. Мы предлагаем бесплатное обучение, гибкий график, оклад и бонусы от продаж, возможность карьерного роста и поддержку в команде.

jobs.title: Скрипт парсер
jobs.description: Требуется разработка скрипта для парсинга сайта indeed.com. Скрипт должен работать на запросах для экономии трафика и поддерживать фильтрацию по странам. Необходимо также создать минимальный графический интерфейс. Основная задача — извлечение почтовых адресов из резюме на страницах выдачи по заданным фильтрам. Нейросети использовать не следует.

jobs.title: Настроить парсинг товаров с американских сайтов в CSV для AdvantShop
jobs.description: Требуется настроить парсинг товаров с американских сайтов West Elm и Anthropologie, включая декор, свет и текстиль. Необходимо собрать около 2000-3000 позиций, используя прокси США для отображения цен. Данные должны содержать артикул, наименование, описание, свойства, цены в USD и ссылки на фото. Важно реализовать автоматический перевод на русский и конвертацию цен в рубли. Результат должен быть в формате CSV, адаптированном под AdvantShop.

jobs.title: Прога нужна для пирсинга контактов НОВЫХ грузовладельцев, Срочно
jobs.description: Требуется разработать программу для извлечения контактов новых грузовладельцев с сайта АТИ.СУ. Необходимо получать данные о зарегистрированных пользователях, включая код, имя и город. Важно учитывать, что искомые контрагенты не имеют рейтинга и могут быть зарегистрированы в любое время. Дополнительно требуется сопровождение программы для обхода блокировок со стороны АТИ.СУ.

jobs.title: Парсинг срочно
jobs.description: Требуется собрать информацию из двух Telegram-каналов и структурировать её в таблице. Задача включает в себя анализ контента и правильное оформление данных для удобного использования.

jobs.title: Мне нужно сделать шоп
jobs.description: Необходимо разработать интернет-магазин на платформе WordPress. Требуется спарсить товары и загрузить их в магазин. Также важно привести внешний вид магазина в опрятный и привлекательный формат. Магазин будет готовиться к дальнейшему продвижению через Google Ads.

jobs.title: Аналитик цен рынка
jobs.description: Требуется аналитик цен для работы с данными в компании-поставщике. Основные задачи включают перенос информации, проверку цен и выявление ошибок. Дистанционный формат работы с гибким графиком и возможностью обучения. Наличие компьютера или смартфона обязательно.

jobs.title: «создание бота для парсинга и бронирования».
jobs.description: Необходимо разработать бота для парсинга и бронирования электронных записей на переезд за границу. Бот должен эффективно собирать данные и обеспечивать процесс бронирования. Ожидается проработка функционала и интерфейса.

jobs.title: Парсер изображений с сайта
jobs.description: Необходимо спарсить около 20000-30000 эмблем команд с указанного URL. Эмблемы должны быть сохранены в формате PNG, а каждому изображению присвоить имя соответствующей команды. Сам парсер не требуется, только изображения.

jobs.title: контент менеджер
jobs.description: Необхідно виконати веб-скрепінг для збору даних з сайту з подальшим експортом у CSV файл для платформи Shopify. Основна вимога – точність та структурованість отриманих даних. Також передбачено постійне обслуговування асортименту сайтів.

jobs.title: Парсинг лидов срочно
jobs.description: Необходимо выполнить парсинг лидов с учетом предоставленного ТЗ. Оплата составляет 1 доллар за каждый лид. Важно учитывать стоп-список компаний, которые уже заходили. Подробности и требования описаны в документе.

jobs.title: B2B парсинг
jobs.description: Требуется разработка решения для B2B парсинга компаний по заданным параметрам: страна, город и ключевые слова, описывающие индустрию. Интересует парсинг из Google Maps, LinkedIn, Instagram, Europages и Yellow Pages. Рассматриваются как комплексные, так и частичные решения для указанных каналов.

jobs.title: Сайт под сео доделать + спарсить товары с другого сайта с автообновл.
jobs.description: Задача включает доработку сайта под SEO и парсинг товаров с сайта galakmet.ru с автообновлением цен каждый день. Необходимо реализовать фильтрацию товаров в каталоге и обеспечить корректное отображение информации на сайте veles-t.ru.

jobs.title: Scraping website
jobs.description: Необхідно здійснити веб-скрепінг для збору даних з сайту та експорту їх у CSV файл для платформи Shopify. Важливо забезпечити точність і структурованість даних, а також на постійній основі обслуговувати асортимент сайтів.

jobs.title: Расширить функционал 1с
jobs.description: Необходимо расширить функционал 1С, добавив автоматический парсинг телефонного номера из комментариев к заказам. Использовать regex для поиска номера. В случае наличия номера, заменить его в строке получателя или создать новую строку. При нажатии кнопки 'Отправить' добавлять текст о дате отправки СМС в заказ наряд.

jobs.title: Парсинг che168

jobs.title: Full Score Transcription From Tribute Audio
jobs.description:
To perspective applicant:
I have an MP3 recording, located here in this post, of a tribute performance, that I want preserved as a complete, professionally notated score. The source is audio only, so you’ll be working entirely by ear. I need a full conductor-level transcription that captures every part as heard, not a lead sheet or simplified chord chart. Use midi 

Instrumentation to include exactly what is on the recording: bass guitar, a violin section, separate male and female choir lines, horn, piano, and timpani drum, and possibly one other. If you notice additional lines or doublings in the mix, feel free to flag them so we decide together whether they should be added. 

I’m expecting a cleanly engraved score (PDF) plus the editable notation file in the software you use—Sibelius, Finale, or MuseScore or another are all fine. I'm expecting a recording of the completed parts, Mp3, from your Daw, real assigned instruments, to follow along with your pdf, to verify that your score is useable in a Daw. 

Deliverables  
• Full conductor score (PDF)  
• Native notation file (Sibelius/Finale/MuseScore/or other)

Accuracy is key: pitches, rhythms, articulations, dynamics, and clear distribution of parts and sections must reflect the recording faithfully.
Manual Score Preparation (No AI/Software-Assisted Transcription) only manual notation to software for midi. 
Requirements:
In-depth knowledge of classical music theory and notation is preferred.

Music degree preferred.

Score must include every performance nuance: dynamics (pp, p, mf, f, ff), crescendo and diminuendo markings, articulations, tempo indications, and phrasing — a complete, performance-ready director's score, not a simplified lead sheet

Applicants will be asked a brief, substantive question about the music itself (for example: "What is the harmonic resolution at bar 8?") — this is not a test or audition, simply a way to gauge genuine musical fluency

Prior transcription or score-preparation experience required; a sample of past work is mandatory.
NOTE.. a few musical passages may be slightly buried. I am available for questions regarding that issue.

About this project:
This work is personally significant — it's being done as a tribute to my late wife. I'm looking for someone who will treat it with the care and seriousness it deserves.  Thanks Craig

Мы разрабатываем AI-платформу с Telegram-ботом для генерации изображений, видео, аудио и работы с LLM. Два монорепозитория: бот на микросервисной архитектуре и веб-платформа (сайт + админка).

**Стек**
TypeScript · Node.js 20+ · Fastify · grammY
Prisma + PostgreSQL · BullMQ + Redis · S3 · FFmpeg
React · Next.js 14 · Vite · Tailwind
Docker · Turborepo · pnpm · GitHub Actions

**Задачи**
— Backend-сервисы бота: API, воркеры, очереди
— Интеграция новых AI-моделей и провайдеров
— Веб-платформа на Next.js: ЛК, админка, платежи
— Проектирование и миграции БД (Prisma)
— Асинхронная обработка генераций через BullMQ
— Код-ревью, архитектура, CI/CD

— TypeScript от 1 года в продакшене
— Node.js + HTTP-фреймворк (Fastify / Express / Koa)
— PostgreSQL + ORM
— REST API, работа с внешними API
— React и Next.js на базовом уровне
— Git, Docker — уверенный пользователь
— Чтение документации на английском

**Плюсом**
— Telegram-боты (grammY / Telegraf)
— BullMQ / RabbitMQ
— Интеграция с AI API (OpenAI, Anthropic и т.д.)
— Turborepo / pnpm workspaces
— S3 / MinIO
— FFmpeg и обработка медиа
— GitHub Actions
— Prometheus / Grafana

**Условия**
— Полностью удалённая работа
— Современный стек, без легаси
— Влияние на архитектурные решения

• Reserva en tiempo real: el pasajero debe poder solicitar un viaje y recibir confirmación inmediata.

jobs.title: Boost Shopify Sales Campaign
jobs.description:
I run a Shopify store that’s ready for its next growth spurt, and the priority is simple: drive more sales. To get there I want a cohesive plan that blends three pillars—paid social, email marketing, and on-site SEO—into one revenue-focused engine.

Social media advertising  
I need full-funnel campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok: audience research, creative concepts, ad set build-out, pixel events, and ongoing optimisation for ROAS. If you already work inside Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, or similar tools, that’s exactly the hands-on experience I’m after.

Email marketing  
Build and automate revenue-generating flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase) plus two sales-driven broadcasts a month. Klaviyo or Mailchimp is fine as long as segmentation, A/B testing, and clear revenue tracking are baked in.

SEO optimisation  
Conduct a quick technical scan, tighten on-page fundamentals (meta titles, H1s, alt tags), and map out a keyword plan that supports the paid push so organic traffic keeps compounding.

Key deliverables  
• 90-day social ad strategy with creatives and targeting  
• Automated email flows + 2 monthly campaign templates  
• Shopify SEO audit and priority fix list  
• Bi-weekly performance report covering spend, sales, and next actions

Success is measured by a clear lift in sales attributed to these channels, so please be comfortable tying your work to numbers. If this sounds like your kind of project, tell me how you’d structure the first month and include a snapshot of past results for a Shopify store—or a similar e-commerce setup—you’ve scaled.
